purpose: Replay pin for PC-1 stage 2 (AGENTS.md §A.42 item 1). The records in this directory are unchanged from PR #1022. Their controls freeze-check the other OIBridge modules as they stood when PC-1 ran, so the recorded recipe holds only on that module set. This file states the environment in which the recorded results reproduce, using objects reachable from main.

oibridge_others.note: PC-1's original base, reachable from main. The controls check sha256 2d91bf59c2d8f4b367af458dfa5f44d71ce265a5397c1d4f095d67e24f61ce8a over these modules (OIBRIDGE_OTHERS_SHA256 in controls.py).

construction: GIT_INDEX_FILE="$R.idx" git --work-tree="$R" checkout-index -f -- $(GIT_INDEX_FILE="$R.idx" git ls-files -- <the three overlay paths>)
environment.landing_commit: any commit on main that contains the three overlay paths unchanged, for example the merge commit of PR #1089
environment.construction_note: verification/programmes is export-ignore in .gitattributes, so git archive omits the PC-1 directory; the overlay therefore uses a temporary index.

commands.expected_last_line: PC-1 stage 2: token INCONCLUSIVE (void), void_reasons ['0(vi)']; scientific_finding pending exact-head review; failures: none; freeze ok: True
PC-1 stage 2: token INCONCLUSIVE (void), void_reasons ['0(vi)']; scientific_finding pending exact-head review; failures: none; freeze ok: True

commands.expected_decision: token INCONCLUSIVE (void), void_reasons ["0(vi)"], scientific_finding.status "carried under exception"

on_later_trees: Run in place on a later main, the controls report freeze.ok false, untouched_oibridge pass false, an added void reason 0(ii) and scientific_finding.status "withheld: 0(ii)", because the other OIBridge modules have changed since 5914c17c. That outcome is the frozen freeze check working as designed. It does not revise the recorded result.
kernel_controls_on_main: PC1Controls.lean and F2CoherenceControls.lean are built by main's Lean CI (Mathlib bridge: Build, Release gate with #print axioms) like every other OIBridge module.
provenance: PR #1022 at 99dce4b6087d74842d8b0cf032ec1bbe2bbb9b4d; owner decision D-72 (#914 comment 6625889194). Replay verified on 2026-11-04 in normal and -O modes for all three commands.
